purpose: Use the player-provided Sephiria screenshots to establish isolated ground and wall module generation direction. These are source references only, not Unity assets and not an assembled scene.

reference_assembly.method: Deterministic placement of the two recorded sources: wall crop at the rear and tiled ground beneath it. A separate dark tactical-grid review overlay was added only to test readability.
reference_assembly.finding: The wall cap, dark facade and amber floor-facing trim establish depth. The grid reads clearly but is intentionally heavier than the final shared one-native-pixel tactical overlay.

next_generation_raw_sources.note: These are independent newly generated raw sources. They still require native-grid diagnosis and role-specific extraction before they can be called 32x32 ground or 32x40 directional edge assets.

wall_inside_corner_v2.reason: below 1.2 threshold; do not repair by scaling

ground_shortbrick_v3_calm.reason: density reduction improved calmness but broke the 1.2 lattice gate; retain v2 instead

actual_module_assembly_review.scope: 2x2 ground plus two unrotated rear-wall modules at 4x nearest-neighbor display
actual_module_assembly_review.finding: Corner join is readable and grid dimensions remain stable; ground internal contrast is still too dense at 4x and is the next refinement target.

observed_module_language.camera: strict top-down; no oblique or isometric construction
observed_module_language.ground: warm dark short horizontal stone courses; regular 32px tactical boundaries read as fine darker stone seams rather than a printed checkerboard
observed_module_language.wall: three layers: pale weathered stone cap, dark warm ashlar facade, thin amber floor-facing trim; corners/endcaps stay explicit
observed_module_language.contrast: keep floor quieter than walls; use silhouette and the wall cap for spatial depth instead of heavy black tile outlines

next_asset_step: Generate an independent 32x32 native ground tile suite from the ground reference.
Generate independent 32x40 front, left, right and corner wall/outer-edge modules from the wall reference.
Only then assemble a 2x2 validation from those actual modules.
restrictions: Do not directly slice, import, or claim these references as production sprites.
Do not create a full-scene illustration as evidence of modular assembly.
